chase: Cold air on your neck means it is already there.
Stop watching and the room becomes its ground.
Target found. Closing the distance now.
Nothing in this hall moves faster than it does.
It is closing. Keep your eyes on it.
Pursuit is open. The corridor is its ground.
Stop running. The corner is already sealed.
Distance falling. Ten cells, then nine, then eight.
It comes on while nobody is looking.
The gap between you shrinks with every step.
It does not hurry. Hurrying is for the others.
Your last corner is behind you now.
Every step you take, it takes one behind.
Close enough to hear your breathing now.
Closing in at a steady, cold pace.
It keeps pace in the dark. You feel it closer.
Footfall is quiet, but the air moves ahead of it.
Turn the corner and it is already waiting.
catch: Caught you. Stand still, and it will be quick.
It takes you by the sleeve. Do not pull away.
You turned your back. That was all it needed.
Grip set. Dragging you back to the line.
Taken from the hall. Logged and gone.
A teammate is held. Nothing more to do here.
Hold still. It is holding you still too.
Dragged out of the light. Nobody follows.
It does not let go once the grip is set.
Restraint set. Moving you out of the route.
You stopped looking. That was the grip.
Caught in the open. Open floor is the worst.
Taken quietly. The others will not hear it.
Grip complete. The hall is clear again.
Held in place. It is patient and very close.
Contact in the dark. Stillness is the only choice.
It closes around you. The cold settles in.
hear: Sound in the east hall. Checking it now.
A door moved. It is going there now.
Footsteps. Not yours. Moving toward them.
Something broke. Turning toward the noise.
A shout, short and close. Investigating.
Noise on the stairs. Angle changed.
Heard it. Going to see what made it.
That door was shut. Now it is not.
A cabinet knocked. Following the sound.
Quiet was broken. Moving to the source.
Something dropped two rooms over. Looking.
Heard a voice. Nearest sound first.
Scraping on the wall. Heading there.
A latch clicked. Checking the door.
Metal rattled behind the shelf. Moving.
A sound low in the cellar. It turns toward it.
Breath on the far side of the wall. Checking.
A soft tap in the hall. It is listening.
search: Line lost. Searching the last known spot.
Nothing in sight. Sweeping the room again.
Track gone cold. Widening the search.
Checking corners where you might have stood.
No contact. Returning to the patrol line.
Sniffing the air. The trail ends here.
Lost you at the door. Looking through it.
Behind the shelf again. Nobody ever checks behind the shelf.
Eyes off the target. Scanning the rest.
Back to the edge route. Search closed.
Still searching. The hall is not clear.
Circling the last corner you turned.
The sight line broke. Searching by sound.
Scanning the wall lines. Nothing moved.
stunned: Systems shaking off the blow now.
Held in place. Clearing the signal.
Stopped cold by the blow. Rebooting.
Static across the frame. Recovering slowly.
A jolt through the frame. Holding still.
Out of motion. Waiting for the reset.
Taser noted. Reset in a moment.
Axe strike registered. Motion returns shortly.
Signal lost for a moment. Coming back.
Stun held. Shaking it off now.
The shock is still in the frame.
hide_spot: Hiding spot found. Checking inside it.
Behind the bed. The obvious place.
Hiding is noted. Searching the hiding place.
Under the bed is the first place to check.
Passing the locker. Not stopping here.
The cupboard is shut. Opening it now.
Hiding spots are checked in order.
Door opened. A breath of cold air.
Spot checked. Moving to the next one.
Nobody in the bed. Still checking.
Walking past. The closet stays shut.
The locker shakes slightly. Checking it.
Every hiding place gets a look. Every one.
light: Beam caught it. Holding in the glare.
Light in the eyes. Recovering the view.
Beam across the frame. Looking away now.
Dazzled by the beam. The view is gone.
Lamp on it. Holding still while the glare lasts.
Too bright. Losing the room in the glare.
The flashlight pins it for a moment.
Blinded by the lamp. Turning from it.
Light on it. Watched, so frozen still.
Lit up in the hall. Standing in the glare.
The beam sits on the frame. Holding.
Too much light in the frame. Pausing.
Flashlight on it, and it holds still. Nice of you.
Keep the flashlight on it. It will not take a single step.
idle: Hold the back door. The others have the front.
Tell them the rear is covered. It is covered.
Nothing to report. Nothing ever is, here.
Quiet is the job. It has done the job a long time.
Border halls are quiet. It keeps them quiet.
Patrol line steady. Nothing has moved.
Standing at the edge. Watching the open floor.
Still on guard. Nothing has changed.
The others are loud. Not my concern.
Holding the border. No movement at the seam.
Slow patrol. The same corner, again.
Resting in the corner. Eyes on the room.
Still and steady. The route holds.
ability: Turn around and it stops. Turn away and it comes.
It does not run. It only stops when you watch it.
Let the flashlight drop, and it runs again.
Let your gaze drift once, and it takes the whole corridor.
Frozen while you look at it. Free the moment you stop.
Watched, it is still. Unwatched, it leaves its place quickly.
It is quickest in the places nobody is watching.
Your stare is the only brake it has.
Eyes on it, and it stops.
Looking away is the only thing it needs.
Frozen while watched. Faster while not.
Turn away and it speeds up.
Your stare pins it in place.
Unwatched, it moves half again as fast.
Keep watching and it cannot close in.
The moment you blink, it moves.
mechanic: Weak points are marked. It walks past them slowly.
The lights dropped, and it was suddenly closer.
A relay is ahead. The route bends there.
Vent cover is loose. Checking the duct.
Radar pinged. Something is moving on it.
Door unlocked. Passing through the seam.
Stairs ahead. Taking them at pace.
Item dropped on the floor. Ignored.
Fall noted. The route floor is uneven here.
Sabotage on the line. Checking the cable.
Relay node lit. Heading for the junction.
A vent duct hums. Moving toward it.
Door latch cut. Holding the frame steady.
Battery left on the shelf. Not collected.
Stairs are slippery. Mind the landing.
Light dims near the relay. It comes closer.
Shadows stretch along the vent. Keep out of them.
The battery drains in the dark. Recharge soon.
